name: strict-json-overflow
objective: Fix strict JSON parsing of finite JSON numeric literals whose conversion to float overflows: JsonCodec.parse and decode must reject non-finite parsed floats at any nesting depth with FileFormatError and a useful chained cause. Preserve arbitrarily large integer precision, finite floats, unicode strings, JSON metadata, immutable root models, existing strict constant rejection and serialization behavior. This is numeric overflow, not duplicate-member policy. Do not change tests or other source modules.
